title: Oasis NFT
tagline: A multi-chain NFT marketplace and wallet where each user can buy NFTs by credit card and cash and can view their NFTs from different chains.
description: Oasis NFT Oasis is a marketplace and wallet that is designed to connect to different networks and create a unique user experience. As a user you will be able to see your NFTs from different chains on our platform since we connect to the Ethereum, Polygon and BSC networks. We will make the purchase of NFTs more accessible by connecting with a payment gateway and allowing purchase by credit card and in convenience stores. Our marketplace will be focused on Latin American projects such as digital art, gaming, photography, collectibles, which will be minted on different networks.
how_its_made:
What technologies did you use? Firebase, OAuth, Firestore, WalletConnect, Polygon, Ethereum, IPFS, Pinata, React, Node, Cloudflare, Moralis, Stripe
How are they pieced together? Users log in using a traditional through an OAuth provider to create a custodial account, and optionally link a wallet. After authentication, we attempt to discover all NFTs on supported chains to list them. In our marketplace, people are able to select an NFT and initiate a payment via Stripe, which allows end-users to initiate a convenience-store payment for the NFTs.
If you used sponsor technology how did it benefit your project? WalletConnect allowed us to forget about authenticating every single wallet provider, and just focus on building the rest of the platform. Moralis relieved us from implementing a custom discovery of NFTs on every single supported chain.
How did you impress yourself which what your team built? We got a product we can actually market, with interest shown during the hackathon by artists, well-established collectors and new-to-the-scene people who are interested but confused on how the technology works but still want in on the hype!
